# Agent Event Protocol Fixtures

These fixtures are contract examples for the draft event protocol in
[`docs/design/candidates/event-protocol-v1.md`](../../../design/candidates/event-protocol-v1.md).

They are not runtime output yet. Their job is to make the design record
mechanically checkable before implementation starts.

## Layout

| Path          | Meaning                                                                                           |
| ------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `core/*.json` | Candidate-core v1 event examples that frontend, CLI, and ACP prototypes may use as golden inputs. |

Experimental event ideas from
[`docs/design/parking-lot/event-protocol-extensions.md`](../../../design/parking-lot/event-protocol-extensions.md)
and artifact-dependent events from
[`docs/design/candidates/artifact-storage-v1.md`](../../../design/candidates/artifact-storage-v1.md) intentionally
do not live in `core/`.

## Validation

The Go contract test in `internal/eventprotocol` validates:

- every fixture is valid JSON;
- every event has the required envelope fields;
- `schema_version` is `"1"`;
- `occurred_at` is RFC3339/RFC3339Nano parseable;
- `data` is always a JSON object;
- event types belong to the candidate-core set;
- removed legacy event names fail fast instead of lingering in examples;
- the normalized run lifecycle fixture set covers queued, started, finished,
  failed, cancelled, resumed-from-event, and checkpoint-saved paths;
- core run lifecycle payloads include their required fields;
- sequences are strictly increasing per `run_id`.

The minimal envelope schema lives at
[`docs/schemas/events/v1/envelope.schema.json`](../../../schemas/events/v1/envelope.schema.json).
It intentionally covers only the shared envelope; payload-specific schemas
should be added as runtime emitters are implemented.

name: Cursor Agent Update

# Cursor's public installer points at a mutable latest release. This workflow
# parses that installer as bounded metadata, validates and hashes both official
# Linux archives, and opens a human-reviewed pin update when publication is
# configured. Otherwise it reports check-only results. It never executes the
# installer, approves its own PR, or merges it.

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '23 7 * * 1'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: read

concurrency:
  group: cursor-agent-update
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  UPDATE_BRANCH: automation/cursor-agent-update

jobs:
  update:
    name: Check versioned artifacts
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with:
          ref: master
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false

      - uses: actions/setup-go@b7ad1dad31e06c5925ef5d2fc7ad053ef454303e # v7
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
          cache: true

      - name: Resolve publication mode
        id: publication
        env:
          HAS_APP_CLIENT_ID: ${{ vars.CURSOR_UPDATE_APP_CLIENT_ID != '' }}
          HAS_APP_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.CURSOR_UPDATE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY != '' }}
        run: |
          case "${HAS_APP_CLIENT_ID}:${HAS_APP_PRIVATE_KEY}" in
            true:true)
              echo 'mode=publish' >>"${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
              ;;
            false:false)
              echo 'mode=check-only' >>"${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
              echo '::warning::Cursor Agent updates are check-only: the updater App is not configured. Artifacts will still be validated, but no PR will be published.'
              {
                echo '## Publication setup'
                echo
                echo 'Check-only: neither CURSOR_UPDATE_APP_CLIENT_ID nor CURSOR_UPDATE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY is configured. No write token will be created and no PR will be published.'
                echo
                echo 'Review docs/contributor/development.md before enabling publication: require protected master with a human-only push allowlist, required PRs, strict Required checks, and no administrator bypass. Then configure both App values. To prepare a reviewed update manually, run just cursor-agent-update.'
              } >>"${GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY}"
              ;;
            *)
              echo '::error::Incomplete updater App configuration. Configure both CURSOR_UPDATE_APP_CLIENT_ID and CURSOR_UPDATE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY after meeting the publication protection requirements, or remove both to use check-only mode.'
              exit 1
              ;;
          esac

      - name: Prepare deterministic update branch
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          if git ls-remote --exit-code --heads origin "refs/heads/${UPDATE_BRANCH}" >/dev/null; then
            git fetch origin "refs/heads/${UPDATE_BRANCH}:refs/remotes/origin/${UPDATE_BRANCH}"
            echo "Fetched existing ${UPDATE_BRANCH} for a safe force-with-lease update."
            branch_ref="refs/remotes/origin/${UPDATE_BRANCH}"
            commit_line_file="${RUNNER_TEMP}/cursor-agent-proposal-commit.txt"
            git rev-list --parents -n 1 "${branch_ref}" >"${commit_line_file}"
            read -r -a commit_line <"${commit_line_file}"
            if [ "${#commit_line[@]}" -ne 2 ]; then
              echo "Existing automation branch must contain one non-merge proposal commit." >&2
              exit 1
            fi
            branch_parent="${commit_line[1]}"
            if ! git merge-base --is-ancestor "${branch_parent}" origin/master; then
              echo "Existing automation proposal is not based on master history." >&2
              exit 1
            fi
            branch_changes_file="${RUNNER_TEMP}/cursor-agent-proposal-paths.txt"
            git diff --name-only "${branch_parent}" "${branch_ref}" >"${branch_changes_file}"
            unexpected_branch_changes="$(grep -Ev '^Dockerfile(\.release)?$|^$' "${branch_changes_file}" || true)"
            if [ -n "${unexpected_branch_changes}" ]; then
              echo "Existing automation proposal contains unrelated tracked changes:" >&2
              printf '%s\n' "${unexpected_branch_changes}" >&2
              exit 1
            fi
            open_pr_file="${RUNNER_TEMP}/cursor-agent-open-prs.json"
            gh api --method GET \
              "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls" \
              -f state=open \
              -f base=master \
              -f "head=${GITHUB_REPOSITORY_OWNER}:${UPDATE_BRANCH}" \
              -f per_page=2 >"${open_pr_file}"
            open_pr_count="$(jq 'length' "${open_pr_file}")"
            if [ "${open_pr_count}" -gt 1 ]; then
              echo "Multiple open updater PRs target the deterministic branch; refusing ambiguous publication." >&2
              exit 1
            elif [ "${open_pr_count}" -eq 1 ]; then
              open_pr_number="$(jq -r '.[0].number' "${open_pr_file}")"
              proposal_root="${RUNNER_TEMP}/existing-cursor-agent-proposal"
              mkdir -p "${proposal_root}"
              git show "${branch_ref}:Dockerfile" >"${proposal_root}/Dockerfile"
              git show "${branch_ref}:Dockerfile.release" >"${proposal_root}/Dockerfile.release"
              echo "EXISTING_PROPOSAL_ROOT=${proposal_root}" >>"${GITHUB_ENV}"
              echo "EXISTING_PROPOSAL_PR=${open_pr_number}" >>"${GITHUB_ENV}"
            else
              echo "Existing ${UPDATE_BRANCH} has no open PR; it is stale branch state, not a review boundary."
              echo 'EXISTING_PROPOSAL_ROOT=' >>"${GITHUB_ENV}"
              echo 'EXISTING_PROPOSAL_PR=' >>"${GITHUB_ENV}"
            fi
          else
            ls_remote_status=$?
            if [ "${ls_remote_status}" -eq 2 ]; then
              echo "No existing ${UPDATE_BRANCH}; the first update will create it."
              echo 'EXISTING_PROPOSAL_ROOT=' >>"${GITHUB_ENV}"
              echo 'EXISTING_PROPOSAL_PR=' >>"${GITHUB_ENV}"
            else
              echo "Unable to determine whether ${UPDATE_BRANCH} exists (git ls-remote exit ${ls_remote_status})." >&2
              exit "${ls_remote_status}"
            fi
          fi
          git switch --force-create "${UPDATE_BRANCH}" origin/master

      - name: Validate artifacts and update pins
        id: update
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          PUBLICATION_MODE: ${{ steps.publication.outputs.mode }}
        run: |
          report="${RUNNER_TEMP}/cursor-agent-update.json"
          updater_args=()
          if [ -n "${EXISTING_PROPOSAL_ROOT}" ]; then
            updater_args+=(--existing-proposal-root "${EXISTING_PROPOSAL_ROOT}")
          fi
          go run ./scripts/cursoragentupdate "${updater_args[@]}" >"${report}"

          status="$(git status --porcelain=v1)"
          unexpected="$(printf '%s\n' "${status}" | grep -Ev '^( M|M ) Dockerfile(\.release)?$|^$' || true)"
          if [ -n "${unexpected}" ]; then
            echo "Updater changed files outside its Dockerfile boundary:" >&2
            printf '%s\n' "${unexpected}" >&2
            exit 1
          fi

          changed="$(jq -r '.changed' "${report}")"
          if [ "${changed}" = "true" ]; then
            git diff --quiet -- Dockerfile && { echo "Dockerfile was not updated" >&2; exit 1; }
            git diff --quiet -- Dockerfile.release && { echo "Dockerfile.release was not updated" >&2; exit 1; }
          elif [ -n "${status}" ]; then
            echo "Updater reported no change but left a dirty worktree" >&2
            exit 1
          fi

          previous_version="$(jq -r '.previous_version' "${report}")"
          version="$(jq -r '.version' "${report}")"
          publish="${changed}"
          if [ "${changed}" = "true" ] && \
             remote_parent="$(git rev-parse --verify "refs/remotes/origin/${UPDATE_BRANCH}^" 2>/dev/null)" && \
             [ "${remote_parent}" = "$(git rev-parse origin/master)" ] && \
             git diff --quiet "refs/remotes/origin/${UPDATE_BRANCH}" -- && \
             [ -n "${EXISTING_PROPOSAL_PR}" ]; then
            publish=false
            echo "Existing PR #${EXISTING_PROPOSAL_PR} already contains this proposal on current master."
          fi
          if [ "${PUBLICATION_MODE}" = 'check-only' ]; then
            publish=false
            if [ "${changed}" = 'true' ]; then
              echo '::warning::A validated Cursor Agent update is available, but check-only mode will not publish it. Review this run summary and run just cursor-agent-update to prepare a manual review PR.'
            fi
          fi
          {
            echo "changed=${changed}"
            echo "publish=${publish}"
            echo "previous_version=${previous_version}"
            echo "version=${version}"
            echo "installer_sha256=$(jq -r '.installer_sha256' "${report}")"
            echo "x64_url=$(jq -r '.artifacts[] | select(.architecture == "x64") | .url' "${report}")"
            echo "x64_sha256=$(jq -r '.artifacts[] | select(.architecture == "x64") | .sha256' "${report}")"
            echo "arm64_url=$(jq -r '.artifacts[] | select(.architecture == "arm64") | .url' "${report}")"
            echo "arm64_sha256=$(jq -r '.artifacts[] | select(.architecture == "arm64") | .sha256' "${report}")"
          } >>"${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"

          {
            echo '## Cursor Agent artifact check'
            echo
            echo "- Previous pin: \`${previous_version}\`"
            echo "- Advertised version: \`${version}\`"
            echo "- Changed: \`${changed}\`"
            echo "- Publication mode: \`${PUBLICATION_MODE}\`"
            echo "- Publish proposal: \`${publish}\`"
            echo
            echo 'The installer was parsed as metadata and was not executed.'
          } >>"${GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY}"

      # Reading classic branch protection needs Administration read, but not
      # settings-edit access. Ruleset bypass lists are hidden from read-only
      # callers, so they cannot establish the App exclusion we need here.
      - name: Create protection reader token
        if: steps.publication.outputs.mode == 'publish' && steps.update.outputs.publish == 'true'
        id: protection-token
        uses: actions/create-github-app-token@bcd2ba49218906704ab6c1aa796996da409d3eb1 # v3.2.0
        with:
          client-id: ${{ vars.CURSOR_UPDATE_APP_CLIENT_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.CURSOR_UPDATE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          permission-administration: read

      - name: Require protected default branch
        if: steps.publication.outputs.mode == 'publish' && steps.update.outputs.publish == 'true'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ steps.protection-token.outputs.token }}
          APP_SLUG: ${{ steps.protection-token.outputs.app-slug }}
          APP_CLIENT_ID: ${{ vars.CURSOR_UPDATE_APP_CLIENT_ID }}
        run: |
          app="${RUNNER_TEMP}/cursor-updater-app.json"
          protection="${RUNNER_TEMP}/master-protection.json"
          gh api --header 'X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2026-03-10' \
            "apps/${APP_SLUG}" >"${app}"
          if ! jq -e --arg slug "${APP_SLUG}" --arg client "${APP_CLIENT_ID}" '
            .slug == $slug and
            .client_id == $client and
            .permissions.administration == "read" and
            .permissions.contents == "write" and
            .permissions.pull_requests == "write" and
            ((.permissions.metadata // "read") == "read") and
            ((.permissions | keys - ["administration", "contents", "pull_requests", "metadata"] | length) == 0)
          ' "${app}" >/dev/null; then
            echo '::error::The updater App must grant only Administration read, Contents write, Pull requests write, and automatic Metadata read. Remove extra permissions before publishing.'
            exit 1
          fi

          if ! gh api \
            --header 'X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2026-03-10' \
            "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/branches/master/protection" >"${protection}"; then
            echo '::error::Cannot read classic master protection. Configure the human-only publication boundary in docs/contributor/development.md and grant the updater App Administration read, not write.'
            exit 1
          fi

          if ! jq -e '
            .enforce_admins.enabled == true and
            .allow_deletions.enabled == false and
            .allow_force_pushes.enabled == false and
            (.required_pull_request_reviews | type) == "object" and
            .required_status_checks.strict == true and
            (any(.required_status_checks.contexts[]?; . == "Required checks")) and
            (.restrictions | type) == "object" and
            .restrictions.apps == [] and
            (.restrictions.users | type) == "array" and
            (.restrictions.teams | type) == "array" and
            ((.restrictions.users | length) + (.restrictions.teams | length) > 0) and
            (all(.restrictions.users[]; .type == "User" and (.id | type) == "number" and .id > 0)) and
            (all(.restrictions.teams[]; (.id | type) == "number" and .id > 0))
          ' "${protection}" >/dev/null; then
            echo '::error::master must have classic protection with a nonempty human/team push allowlist and no Apps, no administrator bypass, required PRs, strict Required checks, and deletion/force-push protection. See docs/contributor/development.md.'
            exit 1
          fi
          echo 'Verified publication boundary: the App may propose updates but cannot push or merge into master.' >>"${GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY}"

      # Mint the write token only after trusted code has validated a real
      # change. The App is installed only on this repository and grants
      # Contents and Pull requests read/write plus Administration read. This
      # writer token omits Administration; the built-in token stays read-only.
      # The verified master allowlist excludes this non-administrative App.
      - name: Create updater App token
        if: steps.publication.outputs.mode == 'publish' && steps.update.outputs.publish == 'true'
        id: app-token
        uses: actions/create-github-app-token@bcd2ba49218906704ab6c1aa796996da409d3eb1 # v3.2.0
        with:
          client-id: ${{ vars.CURSOR_UPDATE_APP_CLIENT_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.CURSOR_UPDATE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          permission-contents: write
          permission-pull-requests: write

      - name: Resolve updater App identity
        if: steps.publication.outputs.mode == 'publish' && steps.update.outputs.publish == 'true'
        id: app-user
        env:
          APP_SLUG: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.app-slug }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}
        run: |
          app_user="${APP_SLUG}[bot]"
          echo "name=${app_user}" >>"${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
          echo "id=$(gh api "/users/${app_user}" --jq .id)" >>"${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"

      - name: Commit and push reviewed inputs
        if: steps.publication.outputs.mode == 'publish' && steps.update.outputs.publish == 'true'
        env:
          APP_NAME: ${{ steps.app-user.outputs.name }}
          APP_USER_ID: ${{ steps.app-user.outputs.id }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}
          VERSION: ${{ steps.update.outputs.version }}
        run: |
          git config user.name "${APP_NAME}"
          git config user.email "${APP_USER_ID}+${APP_NAME}@users.noreply.github.com"
          gh auth setup-git
          git add -- Dockerfile Dockerfile.release
          git commit -m "chore(docker): update Cursor Agent to ${VERSION}"

          if remote_sha="$(git rev-parse --verify "refs/remotes/origin/${UPDATE_BRANCH}" 2>/dev/null)"; then
            git push \
              --force-with-lease="refs/heads/${UPDATE_BRANCH}:${remote_sha}" \
              origin "HEAD:refs/heads/${UPDATE_BRANCH}"
          else
            git push origin "HEAD:refs/heads/${UPDATE_BRANCH}"
          fi

      - name: Open or refresh review PR
        if: steps.publication.outputs.mode == 'publish' && steps.update.outputs.publish == 'true'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}
          PREVIOUS_VERSION: ${{ steps.update.outputs.previous_version }}
          VERSION: ${{ steps.update.outputs.version }}
          INSTALLER_SHA256: ${{ steps.update.outputs.installer_sha256 }}
          X64_URL: ${{ steps.update.outputs.x64_url }}
          X64_SHA256: ${{ steps.update.outputs.x64_sha256 }}
          ARM64_URL: ${{ steps.update.outputs.arm64_url }}
          ARM64_SHA256: ${{ steps.update.outputs.arm64_sha256 }}
        run: |
          title="chore(docker): update Cursor Agent to ${VERSION}"
          body="${RUNNER_TEMP}/cursor-agent-update-pr.md"
          {
            echo '## Summary'
            echo
            echo "- updates the bundled Cursor Agent from \`${PREVIOUS_VERSION}\` to \`${VERSION}\`"
            echo '- pins and verifies the versioned Linux x64 and arm64 archives'
            echo '- keeps the update review-only; this PR is never auto-approved or auto-merged'
            echo
            echo '## Supply-chain evidence'
            echo
            echo "The official installer was downloaded as bounded metadata and **not executed**. Its SHA-256 was \`${INSTALLER_SHA256}\`."
            echo
            echo "- Linux x64: [official archive](${X64_URL}) — \`${X64_SHA256}\`"
            echo "- Linux arm64: [official archive](${ARM64_URL}) — \`${ARM64_SHA256}\`"
            echo
            echo 'Both archives passed path-safety, size, entry-count, package-identity, architecture, and executable-shape validation before these hashes were written.'
            echo
            echo '## Review'
            echo
            echo '- [ ] Confirm the advertised version is expected.'
            echo '- [ ] Review the installer digest and both artifact hashes.'
            echo '- [ ] Require the normal Hecate CI checks before merge.'
          } >"${body}"

          if [ -n "${EXISTING_PROPOSAL_PR}" ]; then
            pr_number="${EXISTING_PROPOSAL_PR}"
            gh pr edit "${pr_number}" \
              --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" \
              --title "${title}" \
              --body-file "${body}"
          else
            gh pr create \
              --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" \
              --base master \
              --head "${UPDATE_BRANCH}" \
              --title "${title}" \
              --body-file "${body}"
            created_pr_file="${RUNNER_TEMP}/cursor-agent-created-pr.json"
            gh api --method GET \
              "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls" \
              -f state=open \
              -f base=master \
              -f "head=${GITHUB_REPOSITORY_OWNER}:${UPDATE_BRANCH}" \
              -f per_page=2 >"${created_pr_file}"
            if [ "$(jq 'length' "${created_pr_file}")" -ne 1 ]; then
              echo "Expected exactly one same-repository updater PR after creation." >&2
              exit 1
            fi
            pr_number="$(jq -r '.[0].number' "${created_pr_file}")"
          fi

          gh pr view "${pr_number}" \
            --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" \
            --json url \
            --jq '"Review PR: " + .url' >>"${GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY}"
